a page naming no store keeps the bare \\u0027CarMax\\u0027 with no location; a known CarMax posting stored under bare \\u0027CarMax\\u0027 is moved to its store the next time its detail page is read; proven by extraction tests over the recorded CarMax detail fixture and a test over a page text naming no store; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Found by the owner\\u0027s live CarMax acceptance walk on 2026-09-26 (run 14 in the ledger, six cars saved): every one of the eleven recorded detail pages names its store in its text, yet all six ledger rows carry the dealer \\u0027CarMax\\u0027 with no location. docs/walk.md says the dealer is read from the text through the extraction (\\u0027CarMax Orlando\\u0027 for example), so either the extraction prompt or the grounding drops the store, or the CarMaxDealerName fallback in src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkSites.cs wins over the extracted name; find which and fix that one path. Display and dealer-grade only; no cost figure changes.
